en: Today’s papers address reusable training data for proteomics and integrated analysis of mass cytometry.
MassNet is the priority for deeper reading, especially the distinction between scaling gains and cross-domain generalization. Several journal sources were inaccessible, so coverage is incomplete.
zh: 今天关注蛋白质组学训练数据的可复用性，以及质谱流式分析的统一工作流。
最值得深读的是 MassNet，尤其要区分扩大训练数据的收益与跨域泛化能力。部分期刊来源不可访问，本次覆盖不完整。

papers.title: MassNet: billion-scale AI-ready mass spectral corpus empowering scalable deep learning in proteomics

commentary.en: MassNet standardizes 1.54 billion DDA spectra across 35 species in the traceable MSDT format and supports XuanjiNovo, a nonautoregressive sequencing model trained with progressively masked peptide labels. On peptide-disjoint validation, scaling training from 30 million to 100 million PSMs raised peptide recall from about 0.54 to 0.68. Cross-platform gains are uneven: the 100-million model trails competitors on most nine-species benchmark datasets until additional fine-tuning, making domain-shift evaluation as important as data scale.
commentary.zh: MassNet 用可追溯的 MSDT 格式组织 35 个物种的 15.4 亿张 DDA 谱，并以逐步遮蔽肽段标签的课程学习训练非自回归测序模型 XuanjiNovo。在肽段序列互斥的验证集上，训练量从 3000 万增至 1 亿 PSM 后，肽段召回率约从 0.54 升至 0.68。跨平台优势并不一致：1 亿模型在九物种基准的大多数数据集上仍落后于其他方法，追加微调后才改善，提示规模扩张需同时检验分布迁移。

papers.title: Seumetry: a versatile and comprehensive R toolkit to accelerate high-dimensional flow and mass cytometry data analysis

commentary.en: Seumetry combines flow- and mass-cytometry processing with Seurat for quality control, visualization, population-abundance testing and protein-expression analysis. The authors report agreement with manual gating on public datasets alongside an intestinal immune-cell example. Its value is an integrated workflow for single-cell marker intensities; the abstract does not establish numerical gains, rare-population error rates or superiority over other toolkits.
commentary.zh: Seumetry 将流式及质谱流式的专用处理接入 Seurat，整合质控、可视化、细胞群丰度检验和蛋白表达分析。作者在肠道免疫细胞数据及公共数据上报告了与人工门控的一致性。其价值是面向单细胞标记强度的质谱流式工作流整合；摘要尚不足以判断具体增益、稀有群体误差或相对其他工具的优势。
